title: 02. Ingestion & Chunking: Handling Multi-Modal Documents (Text + Tables + Images)
summary: Real-world documents are multi-modal: a financial report contains text paragraphs, data tables, and charts; a technical manual has diagrams and numbered figures.

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: Real-world documents are multi-modal: a financial report contains text paragraphs, data tables, and charts; a technical manual has diagrams and numbered figures. Standard text extractors lose table structure (flattening rows into unreadable text) and completely skip images. Multi-modal RAG requires specialized handling: tables are converted to structured Markdown or natural language descriptions, images are passed through vision models (GPT-4o Vision, LLaVA) to generate text descriptions, and charts are analyzed for their data representation. This is one of the most complex areas of production RAG, requiring careful pipeline design.

sections.title: ② Key Code
sections.body:
```python
import base64
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage
from langchain_core.documents import Document

async def describe_image_with_vision(
    image_path: str,
    context: str = "",
    llm: ChatOpenAI = None
) -> Document:
    """Use GPT-4o Vision to generate text description of an image."""
    if llm is None:
        llm = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o", max_tokens=500)
    
    # Load and encode image
    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
        image_data = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode()
    
    ext = Path(image_path).suffix.lower().lstrip(".")
    media_type = {"jpg": "jpeg", "jpeg": "jpeg", "png": "png"}.get(ext, "jpeg")
    
    message = HumanMessage(content=[
        {
            "type": "text",
            "text": f"""Describe this image in detail for a search system.
Context from surrounding text: {context}

Include:
1. What the image shows (chart type, diagram type, photo subject)
2. Key data points or values visible
3. Labels, titles, axes if present
4. Main conclusions or insights

Be specific and thorough — this description will be used to answer questions about this document."""
        },
        {
            "type": "image_url",
            "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/{media_type};base64,{image_data}"}
        }
    ])
    
    response = await llm.ainvoke([message])
    
    return Document(
        page_content=response.content,
        metadata={
            "source": image_path,
            "element_type": "image_description",
            "original_image": image_path,
        }
    )

def table_to_markdown(table_data: list[list]) -> str:
    """Convert table (list of rows) to Markdown format."""
    if not table_data:
        return ""
    
    # Header row
    headers = table_data[0]
    md = "| " + " | ".join(str(h) for h in headers) + " |\n"
    md += "| " + " | ".join("---" for _ in headers) + " |\n"
    
    # Data rows
    for row in table_data[1:]:
        md += "| " + " | ".join(str(cell) for cell in row) + " |\n"
    
    return md

def table_to_natural_language(headers: list, rows: list) -> str:
    """Convert table to natural language for better semantic search."""
    sentences = []
    for row in rows:
        parts = [f"{headers[i]}: {row[i]}" for i in range(min(len(headers), len(row)))]
        sentences.append(". ".join(parts) + ".")
    return " ".join(sentences)

# Full multi-modal PDF ingestion using Docling
async def ingest_multimodal_pdf(pdf_path: str, llm: ChatOpenAI) -> list[Document]:
    """Extract text, tables, and images from a PDF."""
    from docling.document_converter import DocumentConverter
    from docling.datamodel.pipeline_options import PipelineOptions, TableFormerMode
    
    # Configure Docling for rich extraction
    pipeline_options = PipelineOptions(
        do_table_structure=True,          # Extract table structure
        table_structure_options={"mode": TableFormerMode.ACCURATE},
        do_ocr=True,                      # OCR for scanned content
        images_scale=2.0,                 # Higher res image extraction
    )
    
    converter = DocumentConverter(pipeline_options=pipeline_options)
    result = converter.convert(pdf_path)
    
    all_documents = []
    
    for element in result.document.iterate_items():
        if element.label == "text":
            # Regular text paragraph
            all_documents.append(Document(
                page_content=element.text,
                metadata={"source": pdf_path, "element_type": "text", "page": element.page}
            ))
        
        elif element.label == "table":
            # Convert table to both Markdown and natural language
            headers = [cell.text for cell in element.data.grid[0]]
            rows = [[cell.text for cell in row] for row in element.data.grid[1:]]
            
            md_table = table_to_markdown([headers] + rows)
            nl_table = table_to_natural_language(headers, rows)
            
            all_documents.append(Document(
                page_content=f"Table:\n{md_table}\n\nSummary: {nl_table}",
                metadata={"source": pdf_path, "element_type": "table", "page": element.page}
            ))
        
        elif element.label in ["picture", "figure", "chart"]:
            # Describe image with vision model
            image_path = f"/tmp/img_{hash(element.text)}.png"
            element.image.save(image_path)
            
            surrounding_text = element.text or ""
            img_doc = await describe_image_with_vision(image_path, surrounding_text, llm)
            img_doc.metadata.update({"page": element.page, "source": pdf_path})
            all_documents.append(img_doc)
    
    return all_documents
```

sections.title: ④ Visual Explanation
sections.body:
```
MULTI-MODAL DOCUMENT HANDLING
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

PDF DOCUMENT CONTENTS:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Annual Report Q3 2024                                  │
│                                                         │
│  Revenue grew 23% YoY. [TEXT PARAGRAPH]                 │
│                                                         │
│  ┌────────────────────────┐                             │
│  │ Quarter │ Revenue │ YoY│   [TABLE]                   │
│  │  Q1     │  $1.2B  │+18%│                             │
│  │  Q2     │  $1.5B  │+21%│                             │
│  │  Q3     │  $1.7B  │+23%│                             │
│  └────────────────────────┘                             │
│                                                         │
│  [BAR CHART: Revenue trend Q1-Q3]   [IMAGE/CHART]       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

EXTRACTION PIPELINE:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TEXT PARAGRAPH:
  "Revenue grew 23% YoY."
  → Document(page_content="Revenue grew 23% YoY.", element_type="text")

TABLE:
  Raw: Grid with headers and values
  → Markdown: "| Quarter | Revenue | YoY |\n| Q1 | $1.2B | +18% |..."
  → Natural Language: "Quarter: Q1. Revenue: $1.2B. YoY: +18%. ..."
  → Document(page_content=markdown+nl, element_type="table")

IMAGE/CHART:
  Raw: PNG image bytes
  → GPT-4o Vision: "This bar chart shows quarterly revenue for 2024.
                     Q1: $1.2B, Q2: $1.5B, Q3: $1.7B (23% YoY growth).
                     The trend shows consistent acceleration."
  → Document(page_content=vision_description, element_type="image_description")

RETRIEVAL RESULT:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Query: "What was Q3 revenue growth?"
Retrieved:
  1. Table chunk: "Q3: $1.7B, +23%"           (from table)
  2. Vision description: "Q3 shows $1.7B, 23% growth" (from chart image)
  3. Text: "Revenue grew 23% YoY"              (from paragraph)

Answer: "Q3 2024 revenue was $1.7 billion, representing 23% year-over-year growth [Table, p.4][Chart, p.4]."
```
